summary: Banner Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Pacific Financial Corporation. Under the terms, each share of Pacific Financial common stock will be converted into 0.2633 shares of Banner common stock, with fractional shares paid in cash based on a 15-day average closing price. The boards of both companies unanimously approved the merger. The transaction is structured as a merger of Pacific Financial into Banner, with Banner as the surviving entity. Stock options will vest and be canceled for cash if the exercise price is below the merger consideration. Regulatory approvals and customary closing conditions are required. Watch for shareholder votes and the transaction's expected close in late 2026.
